title: Past Simple and Past Continuous: memorable moments

sections.title: Lesson notes: two past tenses
sections.content:
Past Simple tells the main completed events in a story: I met her. The bus arrived. Past Continuous gives the background or an action in progress: I was walking home.

Put them together: “I was walking home when I met an old friend.” The long action is was walking; the short event is met. Türkçe ipucu: was/were + -ing devam eden eylemdir.

questions.prompt: Complete: “I ___ home when I saw the message.”
Which sentence has a short completed event?
choices: I was waiting for the train.
While I cooked, the phone was rang.
While I was cook, the phone rang.
While I was cooking, the phone was ringing yesterday.
While I was cooking, the phone rang.

sections.title: Meetings and memories
sections.content:
A chance meeting is an unexpected meeting. A planned meeting is arranged before it happens. A memorable moment is one you remember clearly. Use run into for meeting someone unexpectedly: “I ran into an old classmate at the station.”

Read each expression aloud, then make one sentence about a real or imagined meeting.

choices: I was planning into my friend.
I ran into a colleague near the station.

sections.title: Reading: an unexpected meeting
sections.content:
Read: “On Friday evening, Selin was leaving a bookshop when she heard someone call her name. It was Eren, a friend from university. They had not seen each other for years. While they were talking, the rain started. They went to a nearby café and shared a coffee. Eren was visiting the city for work, so the meeting was completely unexpected. Before they left, they made a plan to meet again next month.”

Read once for the story. Read again and notice every Past Simple and Past Continuous verb.

questions.prompt: Where was Selin when she heard her name?
What happened while they were talking?

choices: Eren was only visiting for work.

sections.title: Listen for the sequence
sections.content:
Use a device read-aloud tool or ask a study partner to read this twice: “Mert was travelling to Ankara when his train stopped for forty minutes. At first, he was worried because he had an important appointment. Then he called the office and explained the delay. When the train finally arrived, the appointment had moved to a later time.”

First listen for the problem. Then listen for Mert’s solution. Repeat the useful phrase: “I called and explained the delay.”

questions.prompt: What was Mert doing when the train stopped?

sections.title: Speaking: tell a memorable moment
sections.content:
Tell a one-minute story about a memorable meeting, journey, or surprise. Use this order: 1) Set the scene with Past Continuous. 2) Say what happened with Past Simple. 3) Explain the result.

Starter: “Last month, I was … when … happened. While we were …, … . In the end, … .” Speak once slowly, then again more naturally.

sections.title: Final review
sections.content: Complete the questions, then write a six-sentence mini story. Include a chance meeting, one while sentence, one when sentence, and a clear ending.

choices: I was reading when my friend called.
I read when my friend was call.
I was read when my friend called.
I reading when my friend call.

questions.prompt: Complete: “While they ___ coffee, they discussed old memories.”

choices: What you were doing when she arrived?
What did you doing when she arrived?
What were you doing when she arrived?
What were you do when she arrived?

questions.prompt: Which ending fits a story about a chance meeting?
choices: I am meeting her tomorrow yesterday.
We were always meet by chance.
The bookshop was run into us.
We exchanged numbers and planned another coffee.
